      INTO ( gv_result_a, lv_result_b )
      FROM dtab
      WHERE any_field NE space.

    SELECT MIN( aa ) AS a, MAX( bb ) AS b, SUM( cc ) AS c, " comment
           STDDEV( ee ) AS e, CORR_SPEARMAN( ff, gg ) AS f
      FROM any_table
